quest.title: Wanmin Fresh
quest.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm busy at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sure. Just need to think of some other person who can get it there...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Be careful out there in the Guyun Stone Forest. Mind you don't get attacked by some ill-starred thing.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Curious Zi'rui

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Why isn't the food here yet? It's been ages...

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! I'll head back to Liyue Harbor once I finish eating.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That's right. That boy Zi'rui ordered some Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup from us. As I recall, he should be off wandering in the Guyun Stone Forest right about now.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: So many young people, all headed out to that weird place — what is Liyue coming to nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Whatever the case may be, could I trouble you to deliver this meal to him? <color=#00E1FFFF>Just don't fly about too much,</color> or the soup'll spill out.

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Something tells me I shouldn't be here...
